newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) on Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The turnover fell to 1.388 billion yuan from 1.644 billion last Friday. The 90-day contact was the most actively traded.

But overall, trading was not as active as expected despite the participation of foreign banks, partly because foreign banks are only allowed to trade through the second-tier market, which has little impact on the first-tier market, traders said.
The buoyant domestic A share market continued to have some positive impact on the interbank market, they said.
